description: Chesnaught lead backed by Golisopod as a consistent water-resistant safe swap, with Alolan Sandslash as the closer. Sandslash's steel typing and Drill Run/Shadow Claw handle the grass core-breakers (Ludicolo, Abomasnow, Cradily) that give Chesnaught trouble.
performanceNotes: Sandslash covers Chesnaught's grass weaknesses with steel resistance
Golisopod is a more consistent safe swap than Barbaracle, resisting all water moves
